Três caminhos até o mesmo lugar: Three paths to the same place
WebMCP spec, draft of October 16, 2026, §6.3.1. Click each path.
Instrução escondida no nome, na descriçã: A hidden instruction in the name, the description, or a parameter's description of the tool (tool poisoning). Who attacks: the site itself, or a third-party script it loads.
Instrução dentro do que a ferramenta dev: An instruction inside what the tool returns: a review, a forum post, a comment. Who attacks: any visitor who writes on your site.
A ferramenta de alto valor (trocar senha: The high-value tool (change password, pay) becomes a new path for a hijacked agent. The spec reminds us: the agent's path may have different validation from the button's.
Descrição, saída e pedido do usuário che: Description, output, and user request arrive as text in the same context. The spec says: natural language is ambiguous and hard to sanitize. That is why no filter closes the door.
Os três caminhos são do lado do site. O: All three paths are on the site side. What happens inside the agent (and how to reproduce it with a fake agent) belongs to the LOOP-R Track, injection lesson.
